feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 5 August 2026 10:40pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 05 August 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure between Scotland and Scandinavia. High to the north of the Azores with an associated ridge to southeast Iceland, slowly transferring eastwards.


##Wind##

West or west-northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 tomorrow morning, then easing west or southwest 3 or 4 during the afternoon, perhaps increasing locally 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow morning, then mostly slight tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming mainly fair tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, perhaps locally 5 at times, backing on Friday afternoon to mainly south-southwest 4 or 5.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
